summary: Fatal-halt entry point (ABI lead Halt_Assert_Handler): invokes the global halt-handler function pointer off_5DA714, passing the message string aHaltingProgram as its single argument, then traps with __debugbreak() so execution stops if the handler returns. Returns the value produced by the handler call.

operations.description: Indirect call through the global function pointer off_5DA714 with the message string literal aHaltingProgram as its argument; the static callgraph resolves the target to sub_52E4E0. The handler's return value is stored as result.
If the handler returns, __debugbreak() raises a breakpoint trap to halt the program.
Return the value produced by the halt-handler call.
